title: Records abroad and his European following
summary: Freeman says anyone who made many records does well in Europe because audiences know them.

story.theme_name: Going abroad: American jazz musicians touring and living in Europe
story.community_name: Going abroad: touring Europe and Japan

blocks.x: And of course, you were making a good many records here and there.
Oh, yes, I was recording all the time.
All the time [in the markets.] They were being released abroad and so on.

Yes, that's true, anybody who made a lot of records can do very well over here, because people remember the records. In fact, in concerts I do today, they'll come back and say you didn't play it that way on the record. They know, you see.
